purpose: Public aggregate record of the frozen train/tune paired A/B diagnostic for horizontal accelerometer-bias observability.

paired_decision.decision_reason: The candidate reduced some tune failures but did not close the non-zero-bias train boundary or demonstrate generalization. Scalar prior/P/Q changes are not accepted as a product fix.

interpretation.primary_hypothesis: Tilt and horizontal accelerometer-bias observability remain coupled under the declared excitation and covariance model.
negative_conclusions: The result does not justify widening accuracy or settling gates.
The result does not prove that the ESKF is mathematically unobservable in all trajectories.
The result does not establish non-inferiority to PX4.
The result does not support long-duration GNSS-denied inertial navigation claims.
The result does not establish FCOne v2 flight readiness.
interpretation.next_protocol: Create a clean v2 train/tune campaign with a pre-registered excitation-aware estimator hypothesis, then execute a protected sealed holdout exactly once after source and gates are frozen.

information_markers.purpose: Analyzer-only timing classification relative to pre-declared motion milestones.
limitations: Markers are not an observability proof or rank test.
Markers do not enter the estimator and do not use truth initialization.
Release holdout trajectories intentionally have no public marker and are classified as unavailable_sealed_holdout rather than assigned a public information state.

provenance_limitations: The historical A/B runs used compact output and were launched from a dirty working tree.
Historical summaries did not retain per-trial input CSV SHA-256, byte count, or row count; no missing SHA values were fabricated retroactively.
The historical v1 smoke selector exposed seed 30000 from both holdout trajectories, so v1 holdout evidence is diagnostic only and not a blind release result.
The new runner captures input CSV SHA-256, bytes, and data rows before compact mode deletes the input, and records protocol/marker fingerprints in each campaign summary.

exit_code_semantics.comparator_return_code_1: policy or capability failure after a valid comparison result; it is not a program crash
exit_code_semantics.execution_failure: a trial could not produce a valid result and is reported separately
